goal.insight: Show the relationship between education spending as a share of GDP and multiple outcome metrics across 30 countries, making any non-linear or scattered patterns visually prominent
Highlight countries that spend heavily on education but show divergent outcomes across PISA scores, university enrollment, and youth unemployment
Emphasize countries that achieve strong educational outcomes (high PISA, high enrollment, low youth unemployment) despite moderate or low spending levels
Visually contrast youth unemployment rates against education spending and PISA scores to reveal where labor market outcomes decouple from educational investment
Encode education spending on the x-axis, PISA score as y-axis, bubble size as university enrollment rate, and bubble color as youth unemployment rate, with country labels on notable cases
